items.description: Active immutable release. configRevision is the frozen cloud Source revision. sourceRevisionState compares it to currentConfigRevision; a stale binding remains visible until redeployed. Times are Unix milliseconds. Collection commit and run error summarize terminal program tasks in the last 24 hours. Only completed transactions with Collection writes count. Multiple-source programs omit output, checkpoint and run error attribution. lastSourceCallAt is successful host-call completion. sourceReportedCollectedAt is optional and comes from a Source read result. Checkpoints show current durable metadata without state values. edgeSubscriptions includes Edge watch acquisition, ACK and fault status.
